parties.ourParty: Verizon Owner Trust 2020-A, together with Verizon ABS LLC (Issuer and Depositor)
parties.counterparty: Cellco Partnership d/b/a Verizon Wireless (Servicer, Marketing Agent and Custodian)

plans.note: Primary: Section 9.7 Limitation of Liability (p0380-p0382) and Section 6.2 Liability of Servicer and Marketing Agent (p0283 'Liability for Specific Obligations'), with Depositor counterpart Section 5.2 (p0243). Secondary disclaimers p0148, p0191, p0338; p0469 bars punitive/consequential damages in arbitration. Assess mutuality, carve-outs and absence of any monetary cap.

Section 6.3 Indemnities of Servicer and the Marketing Agent (p0288-p0299) is the vendor-side indemnity to the Issuer, Owner Trustee and Indenture Trustee; p0293 Proceedings/defense, p0296 survival, p0299 recoupment. p0117 is a Servicer indemnity for extensions/modifications. p0372 is our own defend-title covenant (do not flag).

No non-compete or field-of-use restriction on us. Hits are generic 'contractual restriction' representations (p0240, p0266, p0279) and a servicing-software transfer restriction (p0346). Expect not applicable.

No sole-source or exclusive purchase obligation. 'Exclusive' appears only re control of the Cap Collateral Account (p0387-p0388) and nonexclusive jurisdiction (p0427). Confirm Section 3.1 Engagement (p0080) is an appointment, not an exclusivity covenant.
No most-favoured-nation or 'no less favorable' pricing language located in the agreement, appendix or exhibits. Absent; no MFN burden on us.
No employee non-solicitation or no-hire covenant found (solicit / hire / employ returned nothing responsive). Absent.

Section 7.1 No Resignation (p0314) prevents the Servicer walking away — favourable to us. Section 7.2 Servicer Termination Events (p0317-p0318) is our for-cause removal right, preserved by p0286; Section 7.3 (p0329). Section 8.3 (p0363) automatic termination; Sections 8.1/8.2 (p0351, p0358) optional acquisition/redemption exits. Assess whether any convenience exit exists for us.

No auto-renewal, renewal term or non-renewal notice window; term runs until final payment (Section 8.3, p0363). Structurally inapplicable to this securitization — expect missing/not applicable rather than a redline.

Section 10.5 GOVERNING LAW selects New York (p0426) — accepted; Section 10.6 nonexclusive SDNY jurisdiction (p0427); Section 10.7 jury waiver (p0429). Section 11.2 (p0450-p0469) allows mediation or binding AAA/JAMS arbitration for repurchase disputes; confirm it is limited and domestic, not a foreign arbitration displacing courts.

Section 10.2 Assignment; Benefit of Agreement; Third-Party Beneficiary (p0405 et seq.) is core; successor-by-merger provisions appear twice — Section 5.3 for the Depositor (p0249) and Section 7.6 for the Servicer (p0348). Check affiliate/successor assignment freedom for us and any vendor exit on our change of control.

Records/data ownership runs through Section 3.10 Custodian (p0138-p0147) — Cellco holds Receivable Files for the Issuer/Indenture Trustee and must deliver them; p0048 is the back-up Grant. Key risk: p0346 (Servicer not obliged to license or assign processes, models or servicing software). p0446 covers removal of Personally Identifiable Information.

No licence grant clause — this is a transfer/servicing agreement. Only licence-adjacent text is p0346 (no obligation to license servicing software to a Successor Servicer); analyse there under IP/TRANSITION and avoid double-flagging. p0234, p0259, p0272 are regulatory licensing reps.

Audit rights run in our favour: p0131 grants access to records to review Servicer performance; Section 6.6/6.7 (p0303-p0312) require compliance statements, Reg AB servicing assessment and accountants' attestation (certification form at p1048); Article XI Asset Representations Review (p0441-p0446). No audit of customer usage — do not flag provisions benefiting us.

No liquidated damages or termination penalty payable by us to the Servicer. Make-Whole Payments (p0351-p0362, p0398) are Noteholder economics on optional redemption; late fees (p0094, p0990) are Obligor charges within the Supplemental Servicing Fee. Note rather than redline.

Performance standard in Section 3.2 (p0082, p0091 — Servicing Procedures, commercially reasonable care and diligence, no less than for its own receivables); Servicer/Marketing Agent reps in Section 6.1 (p0257, p0269, p0270). Remedy is reacquisition/acquisition for breach: Sections 2.5/2.6 (p0068-p0071) and Section 3.3 (p0109-p0113, p0117). p0062 confirms reps survive termination and are non-waivable.

No vendor insurance covenant (CGL, E&O, cyber). Only hits are Obligor insurance premiums billed to accounts (p0095) and FDIC deposit insurance in the Qualified Institution definition (p0903). Expect missing; weigh materiality given the Parent Support Agreement credit support.

No take-or-pay or minimum purchase commitment on us. Required Acquisition Deposit / Negative Carry constructs (p0225, p0398, p0927, p0564) are revolving-period waterfall mechanics; p0211 imposes a deposit obligation on the Marketing Agent (counterparty side).

Section 7.5 Transition of Servicing (p0342-p0347) with Section 7.3 Continue to Perform (p0329) and Section 7.4 Successor Servicer (p0335-p0340); p0147 requires delivery of Receivable Files to the Indenture Trustee or successor custodian. Key carve-back at p0346 (no obligation to provide processes, models, servicing software or restricted materials) — assess adequacy and coordinate with IP to avoid double-flagging.
